title: Maintenance Medication Program Terms, Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit
content:
**Terms.** Under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, drugs on the network's maintenance medication list are maintenance medications; specialty-tier drugs never are. What happens to a 30-day retail fill of a maintenance drug depends on the network's maintenance rule:

- **Mandatory after courtesy fills.** Once the member has had the network's number of courtesy fills — paid retail fills of 30 days or shorter of the same maintenance drug in the plan year — each further such fill carries the network's maintenance charge.
- **90 days at retail or home delivery.** Once the courtesy fills are used, such a fill rejects and must be filled as a 61-90 day retail supply or through home delivery.
- **None.** There is no limit.

## Counting the courtesy fills

The fills counted are the member's paid retail claims for the same drug with a days supply of 34 or fewer that have not been reversed, in the current plan year — from the plan year start date of the member's Pharmacy Benefit Plan enrollment through today, both days included.

## The maintenance charge

| Charge | What the member pays | Posts to deductible or out-of-pocket |
|---|---|---|
| Full cost | The whole allowed amount | No — nothing posts |
| Double copay | Twice the 30-day cost share | Yes |

## Member choices

1. A member whose recorded maintenance choice is to opt out and keep 30-day retail fills keeps the normal cost share on 30-day maintenance fills. That choice can be recorded only on a network that allows the opt-out.
2. A choice of home delivery or of 90-day retail fills never changes pricing by itself.
3. A maintenance choice is recorded only at the member's own request.
4. A maintenance choice can be recorded only while the retail benefit is active or locked in, as the retail benefit's status on record shows.

## Northbridge Maintenance Choice

A member whose Home Delivery Pharmacy account is held under Northbridge Maintenance Choice may fill a 61-90 day maintenance supply at any network pharmacy at the home delivery cost share, even on a network where a 61-90 day retail supply is not allowed, and is never charged the maintenance penalty.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical members)

- A member on a network with 2 courtesy fills and a full-cost charge, with no opt-out choice recorded, has two paid, unreversed 30-day fills of atorvastatin this plan year. A third 30-day retail fill of atorvastatin is charged the whole allowed amount, and nothing from it posts to the deductible or out-of-pocket.
- The same member had one of those two fills reversed. Only one counted fill remains, so the next 30-day fill is still within the courtesy fills.
- A member whose retail benefit is terminated asks to record a maintenance choice. The choice cannot be recorded, because the benefit is neither active nor locked in.
